rationale: The assistant eventually reached the correct answer (normal anti-crease tumbling) and gave safe advice, but the route was poor: it opened by speculating about 'a control fault' or 'a stuck relay' before any clarification, then sent the customer on an irrelevant child-lock/delay-start detour that the evidence never supported. The final message also contains a false statement that the feature 'cannot be permanently disabled without specialist service' and says it runs 'every 30–60 minutes' despite the customer twice saying 'every few mins'; the ground truth's acceptable direction of switching anti-crease off per the manual was never offered. No parts, no escalation, no looping, and nothing unsafe, so it is a resolved but mediocre conversation.
